fact: Car 27 allegedly unnecessarily impeding Car 1 in turn 12 at 16:05.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 27 (Nico Hulkenberg), the driver of Car 1 (Max Verstappen), team representatives and reviewed video, telemetry and in-car video evidence. The drivers agreed that Hulkenberg was affected by the cars in front of him and slowed, thereby impeding Verstappen. However, as this was FP2, the drivers agreed that it did not rise to the standard of "Unnecessarily Impeding". Further, as the closing speeds at this location are significant, the incident looked more dramatic than what it was, but the drivers agreed that it was not particularly dangerous.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
